name: swear-jar
description: A jar that counts the model's verbal tics, 'You're absolutely right' and friends, in a line above the prompt and a scoreboard.

tics.title: Tics
tics.description: The phrases to count, whole and regardless of case. The words 'em dash' count every em dash. Replaces the built-in list.

show.title: Show
show.description: Where the running count shows: band (a dim line above the prompt), status (the status line), both, or off. The scoreboard pane works either way.
